theme: The last open day before Croatia.
greeting: A clear Labor Day, Dan, and the last open stretch before you and Mike fly out tomorrow evening. Nearly everything still on the board is trip prep, and the parts that matter most can only be closed from dry land today.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia bags before the counter
needsAttention.detail: Your Todoist p1 flags the issued ticket as zero checked bags on the Eurowings Discover legs. Verify the allowance on the operating carrier's own site and buy bags online now, before the airport counter charges European walk-up rates for two 55L duffels.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat night for the 19th
needsAttention.detail: The single night after the charter is still unbooked, and the real deadline is departure, not the 19th. Charter connectivity is poor, so this and the marina transfer have to be booked from dry land before you leave tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Reach the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: The p2 travel task wants Saturday's exact boarding time and location confirmed, plus the return airport transfer for the 19th arranged now, while you still have signal to do it.

needsAttention.title: Call Halloween, St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 5 deadline has passed and the Oct 18 rotation booking fires while you are away at sea. One call settles the St Pete Airbnb, the car, and the Portland house, so it is better made today than from a boat.

flagged.title: Andrew Kaufmann's reconnect note
flagged.detail: He wrote on LinkedIn checking whether you are still at KPMG and would welcome a conversation, a warm networking thread worth a short reply while you are job searching.

flagged.title: Dubrovnik host is waiting on you
flagged.detail: Damjan replied about the Sep 9 to 12 Old Port apartment and needs an answer before you arrive Wednesday.

inbox.noise: The rest is Labor Day sales, cookware and menswear promos, newsletters, and loyalty-tier notices.

recipe.title: Quinces Poached in Muscat
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip
Book the St Pete landing-gap lodging (Sep 20 to 22)
Book the Sep 20 to Oct 5 backup rental car

acts.line: A clear Labor Day with nothing on the calendar, the last open day before the boat.
What is left of the Croatia prep is mostly p1: the bag allowance, the Cavtat night, the instructor.
The last evening with the girls in St. Pete before tomorrow's handoff and the 5:55 flight out.
